title: Wash Hands Song
yt_description:
Learn the importance of washing hands before eating with Pip. This song teaches toddlers a simple and healthy habit in a fun way. Encourage your child to sing along and practice good hygiene.

🎵 Wash Hands Song

Hello
Friends
Let's eat

Before we eat
We wash hands
Clean and bright

Wash hands
Every time
Clean and shine

Wash hands
Every time
Clean and shine

Now we eat
Yum yum
Bye friends

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
